PR #51 is open: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/51

Summary of what shipped:
- Recovered `INS-20260724-053123-0e5a`'s original raw text from the live instructions table — it names all 10 gateways verbatim (G01 Owner … G10 Infrastructure), closing the naming gap without needing a fresh interactive Owner confirmation.
- Extended `generate_engines_gateways_inventory.py` with a `GATEWAY_DISCOVERY` list and ran it live: all 10 gateways verified real prior art on disk (all `partial` coverage, none `NONE`), same rigor as the 20-engine inventory. Also confirmed `scripts/task-gateway.py` is *not* actually one of the 10 named gateways — it was a Phase 0 guess, now corrected.
- Spliced the verified inventory into the phase plan, marked `gateway_definition_and_inventory` (the last open phase) `status: done`, registered it in the knowledge engine, and pushed the PR.

No gateways were built — per the phase's own constraint, this was inventory-only. Building G01–G10 as real request-boundary components is new scope for a future phase.
